title: Great Pyramid chambers aligned to Sirius and Orion in 10,500 BC

tellings.quote: called The King and queen's chamber that face different constellations right the Queen's chamber faces Sirius

related.note: Both say which star targets the Great Pyramid's chamber shafts point at. This telling puts Sirius on the Queen's Chamber, where the story says a Queen's Chamber shaft points at Orion.

plain: The two main rooms inside the Great Pyramid of Giza, known as the King's Chamber and the Queen's Chamber, each point toward a different part of the sky, with the Queen's Chamber facing Sirius, the brightest star, and the design matching Sirius and the constellation Orion as they stood around 10,500 BC. A researcher named Matt LaCroix lays this out on Michels's show in 2024 without naming a source. If so, the pyramid would encode a date far older than the usual history gives it.
